name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen/Emerald; v1.6.4 adds Emerald battle/starter presentation compatibility, improves large-font Modern UI responsiveness, fixes the Gen 2 CONTINUE summary layout, and recalibrates BATTLE UI SIZE so 100% is the new neutral footprint.
